name: Drahomil's apartment
axes: x = west (garden glass, x=0) to east (kitchen). z = south (z=0) to north (sofa wall). y = up.
note: Draft from photos, a video and the owner's corrections. Sizes are rough. Change numbers here; the blueprint image and (later) the level are made from this file.

openings.label: Sliding glass door
openings.note: Sketchfab 'Pro Line Contemporary Sliding Door' (CC BY). Opens when the cat waits in front of it, inside or in the garden.

props.label: Cat tree
props.note: Drahomil's own. Stands next to the court door. Custom model (Kenney has none).

props.label: Kitchen island (drawers + hob)
props.note: White handle-less drawers, dark-grey top. Drawers face the back counter (south). Moved south in v3 to leave a walkway in front of the court glass.

props.label: Back counter (coffee machine)
props.note: Against the south wall, west of the fridge. Wood wall panel behind it.

props.label: Fridge column
props.note: East end of the south wall. (Confirmed by owner.)

props.label: Firewood stack against the building wall

garden_edges.label: Fence to the neighbour's garden: concrete posts, horizontal planks (real south-east)
Old fence at the far end of the wild garden; a broken plank behind the fox's den

spawn.note: Next to the island, like in the video.

courts.label: Inner court (round stones)
courts.note: 1.8 m deep x 3 m wide, same width as the kitchen. Its north and east sides are the outer walls of the house. Wall-high glass on the south (kitchen) and west (living room) sides. Entered through the narrowly open west glass door next to the cat tree.

doors.label: Door
doors.note: Right of the cat tree. Open just wide enough for Drahomil to squeeze through.

courts.shaft_note: The house rises round the open court (light well): about 8.8 m to the gutter, from the height model.

mouse_holes.note: East kitchen wall, next to the fridge.
East kitchen wall, before the court.
West wall, south of the sliding door.

climbables.label: Ivy from the ground up the wall to the flat roof (climbable)
Drainpipe from the low roof back up
Garden shed by the begijnhof wall (the way out)
Drainpipe on the quay shed (way back up)

climbables.note: Chapter 8: holds at 3.3 m (the jingle ball). Chapter 10: the story lets it go on to the gutter at 8.8 m.

climbables.label: Ivy up the back wall of the shed at the garden end (the way home at night)

garden_note: Garden from the owner's description and open aerial data (Digitaal Vlaanderen): a strip about 4.2 m wide and 24 m long. In real life the garden runs north-east from the house; in this file it runs west (game west = real north-east, game south = real north-west, game north = real south-east).
buildings_note: Heights from the open Flemish height model (DHM II surface minus terrain, 1 m) and GRB footprints; game metres, rounded.

buildings.label: Flat roof behind the ivy wall (6.5 m)
Outbuilding at the garden end (4.2 m)
The cat's house, upper floors over the living room (flat roof, 8.8 m)
Upper floors over the kitchen, south of the light well
Upper floors north of the light well
A flat strip of roof between the light well and the front roof (the top of the court drainpipe)
The front of the cat's house on the street: eaves 8.8 m, slate ridge 11.8 m
Neighbour on the street: eaves 8.8 m, tiled ridge 11.2 m

context_note: Scenery only (no colliders): the other buildings of the block, as boxes in game metres (centre, size, yaw, height).

wild_garden.label: The neighbour's wild garden (nobody home for months)

riverside_note: Chapter 4-5: the river and the quay beside the block are at real scale (open VHA waterways, GRB, DHM II); the long stretch to the begijnhof is shortened and stylised, so it does not give a real distance.

grounds.note: Chapter 9: the grass bank with trees between the far end of the wild garden and the river (open aerial data); the quay ends here.

begijnhof.anchor_note: Real footprints and heights of a begijnhof (GRB, DHM II, heritage trees), turned 180 degrees and placed by the river in the game.

quay_lamp.note: Chapter 9: an old lamp-post at the north end of the quay.

buildings_street_note: Chapter 10: the cat's own house and its neighbour on the street, from GRB footprints and DHM heights (median 8.8 m, top 11.2-11.8 m), in game metres.
